response.text: {"anomaly_detected": false, "confidence": 0.6, "anomalies": [], "summary": "I checked the power stage, feedback divider, LDO wiring, INA219 sense and address pins, MCU power and reset/boot networks, I2C pull-ups, crystal and decoupling, and the EEPROM, flash, PWM and sensor wiring against the spec. The only mismatches are the MPRLS RESET/EOC swap (a documented known bug) and the PCA9685 address note (0x41 on the drawing vs 0x40 in the spec), which is consistent with A0 tied high and avoiding a clash with the INA219 at 0x40, so neither is reported."}
